experiments.name: Default (Baseline)
experiments.notes: 21/21 valid JSON; 19/21 content_ok (15/15 grounded, 4/6 ungrounded; 2 ungrounded false assertions).

experiments.name: Basic Exp 1: Lower Rank (lora_r=4, lora_alpha=8)
experiments.notes: 4x fewer trainable parameters (3.19M vs 12.78M); still achieves 100% JSON format compliance, proving low intrinsic dimensionality for syntax formatting, with 18/21 content_ok.

experiments.name: Basic Exp 2: Fewer Epochs (num_train_epochs=5)
experiments.notes: Underfitted at 10 gradient steps: JSON format compliance rises from 9.5% to 85.7% (18/21), but canned abstention phrasing and exact FAQ key retention are incomplete (13/21 content_ok).
